title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Whether the People's Court Shall Accept a Civil Lawsuit Filed by a Party Regarding a Dispute over Compensation and Resettlement Where the Parties Fail to Reach a Demolition Compensation and Resettlement Agreement

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply on Whether the People's Court Shall Accept a Civil Action Filed by a Party for Disputes over Compensation and Resettlement When No Demolition Compensation and Resettlement Agreement Is Reached
Fa Shi [2005] No. 9
Higher People's Court of Zhejiang Province:
We have received your Request No. [2004] 175 from the Higher People's Court of Zhejiang Province, namely the 'Request on Whether the Court Can Accept a Civil Case When the Parties Fail to Reach a Demolition Compensation and Resettlement Agreement and a Party Files a Lawsuit over Compensation and Resettlement Disputes'. Upon study, we reply as follows:
Where the demolisher and the demolished person, or the demolisher, the demolished person and the house lessee fail to reach a demolition compensation and resettlement agreement, and a civil action is filed with the People's Court for the dispute over compensation and resettlement, the People's Court shall not accept the case, and shall inform the parties that they may, in accordance with Article 16 of the Regulations on the Administration of Urban House Demolition, apply to the relevant department for adjudication.
This is our reply.
